art_direction: 一本合拢小书只展开一对纸翼，靛蓝封面与浅金纸页在浅薄荷底形成飞行姿态。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Draw a small closed indigo book hovering at the center, with two of its ivory pages unfolding into broad asymmetrical wings. The wings are paper sheets, not feathered bird anatomy, and each needs only one fold line. Use a pale mint background with no sky elements. A narrow golden page block separates the covers, adding a warm accent to the otherwise restrained palette. Tilt the book slightly as if it has just lifted, with one wing higher than the other. Keep the cover completely blank and omit any title, spine text, or symbols. The design should rely on the clean relationship of rectangular book and curved pages rather than decorative fantasy details.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
